payloadScope: Synthetic accounts/orders, generated native node state, bounded load/RPC/telemetry logs, exact public dependency/build artifact bytes, process/node metadata, controller/guard source and preparation receipts. No private SSH or API key file was collected.
notes: Full SHA/bytes/mode/uid/gid and empty-directory closure independently checked for every outer and nested archive leaf.
Native generated segment/dat/catalog binaries are not interpreted by this marker scan; their inventory/source generation scope is reviewed and complete bytes are preserved.
JARs use full SHA and full ZIP-entry inventories; all actual JAR ZIP contents are scanned for listed credential markers.
